verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל־ לְךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי־ אֲבָנִ֖ים לֻחֹ֥ת כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְכָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים הַלֻּחֹ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh pə·sāl- lə·ḵā šə·nê- ’ă·ḇā·nîm lu·ḥōṯ kā·ri·šō·nîm wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tî ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘al- hā·ri·šō·nîm hal·lu·ḥōṯ ’ă·šer šib·bar·tā
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals and I will write on them - the words that were on the first tablets which you broke

verses.original: וֶהְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָלִ֤יתָ בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י אֶל־ וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛י שָׁ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: weh·yêh nā·ḵō·wn lab·bō·qer wə·‘ā·lî·ṯā ḇab·bō·qer har sî·nay ’el- wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā lî šām ‘al- rōš hā·hār
verses.literal: Be ready in the morning and come up - on Mount Sinai . . . to present yourself before Me . . . on the mountaintop . . .

verses.original: לֹֽא־ וְאִישׁ֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־ אַל־ אִ֥ישׁ יֵרָ֖א בְּכָל־ הָהָ֑ר אַל־ גַּם־ הַצֹּ֤אן וְהַבָּקָר֙ יִרְע֔וּ אֶל־ מ֖וּל הַהֽוּא׃ הָהָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: lō- wə·’îš ya·‘ă·leh ‘im·māḵ wə·ḡam- ’al- ’îš yê·rā bə·ḵāl hā·hār ’al- gam- haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār yir·‘ū ’el- mūl ha·hū hā·hār
verses.literal: No one may go up with you in fact no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain not even the flocks or herds may graze in front of . . . the mountain

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֤ה וַיִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי־ אֲבָנִ֜ים לֻחֹ֨ת כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיִּקַּ֣ח שְׁנֵ֖י אֲבָנִֽים׃ לֻחֹ֥ת בְּיָד֔וֹ וַיַּ֙עַל֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yip̄·sōl šə·nê- ’ă·ḇā·nîm lu·ḥōṯ kā·ri·šō·nîm way·yaš·kêm ḇab·bō·qer way·yiq·qaḥ šə·nê ’ă·ḇā·nîm lu·ḥōṯ bə·yā·ḏōw way·ya·‘al ’el- har sî·nay ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals He rose early in the morning and taking the two stone tablets in his hands he went up . . . Mount Sinai as the LORD - had commanded him

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yê·reḏ be·‘ā·nān way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘im·mōw šām way·yiq·rā ḇə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the LORD descended in a cloud stood with him there and proclaimed His name the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה׀ וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר עַל־ פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׀
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- pā·nāw way·yiq·rā Yah·weh Yah·weh ’êl ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ wɛ·ʾɛ̆·mɛṯ
verses.literal: Then the LORD passed in front of [Moses] and called out The LORD the LORD God is compassionate and gracious slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness

verses.original: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֙סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה לֹ֣א וְנַקֵּה֙ יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל־ בָּנִים֙ וְעַל־ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṣêr ḥe·seḏ lā·’ă·lā·p̄îm nō·śê ‘ā·wōn wā·p̄e·ša‘ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’āh lō wə·naq·qêh yə·naq·qeh pō·qêḏ ‘ă·wōn ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm wə·‘al- bə·nê ḇā·nîm ‘al- šil·lê·šîm wə·‘al- rib·bê·‘îm
verses.literal: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand [generations] forgiving iniquity transgression and sin Yet He will by no means vvv leave [the guilty] unpunished He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren . . . to the third . . . and fourth generations

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְמַהֵ֖ר וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ma·hêr way·yiq·qōḏ ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֔י וַיֹּ֡אמֶר אִם־ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֖י נָא֩ יֵֽלֶךְ־ נָ֥א בְּקִרְבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י ה֔וּא קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֙רֶף֙ עַם־ וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy way·yō·mer ’im- mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy nā yê·leḵ- nā bə·qir·bê·nū kî hū qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am- wə·sā·laḥ·tā la·‘ă·wō·nê·nū ū·lə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯê·nū ū·nə·ḥal·tā·nū
verses.literal: O Lord he said if I have indeed found favor in Your sight my Lord please go . . . with us Although this is a stiff-necked . . . people forgive our iniquity and sin and take us as Your inheritance

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל־ עַמְּךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ נִבְרְא֥וּ וּבְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם בְכָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ כָל־ הָ֠עָם אַתָּ֨ה בְקִרְבּ֜וֹ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁר־ וְרָאָ֣ה יְהוָה֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה כִּֽי־ ה֔וּא נוֹרָ֣א אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî kō·rêṯ bə·rîṯ ne·ḡeḏ kāl- ‘am·mə·ḵā ’e·‘ĕ·śeh nip̄·lā·’ōṯ ’ă·šer lō- niḇ·rə·’ū ū·ḇə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ḇə·ḵāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ḵāl hā·‘ām ’at·tāh ḇə·qir·bōw ’eṯ- ’ă·šer- wə·rā·’āh Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śêh kî- hū nō·w·rā ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: And [the LORD] said Behold I am making a covenant Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world All the people vvv among whom you live - - will see the LORD’s work for it [is] an awesome [thing] that I am doing with you

verses.original: שְׁמָ֨ר־ לְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּךָ֣ הַיּ֑וֹם הִנְנִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִפָּנֶ֗יךָ אֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהַחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mār- lə·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm hin·nî ḡō·rêš mip·pā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Observe - what I command you this day . . . I will drive out before you - the Amorites Canaanites Hittites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־ תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ פֶּן־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- tiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bā ‘ā·le·hā pen- yih·yeh lə·mō·w·qêš bə·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land - you are entering . . . lest they become a snare in your midst

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶת־ תִּתֹּצ֔וּן וְאֶת־ מִזְבְּחֹתָם֙ תְּשַׁבֵּר֑וּן וְאֶת־ מַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תִּכְרֹתֽוּן׃ אֲשֵׁרָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- tit·tō·ṣūn wə·’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·ṯām tə·šab·bê·rūn wə·’eṯ- maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·ṯām tiḵ·rō·ṯūn ’ă·šê·rāw
verses.literal: Rather - you must tear down - their altars smash - their sacred stones and chop down their Asherah poles

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה אַחֵ֑ר לְאֵ֣ל כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁמ֔וֹ קַנָּ֣א קַנָּ֖א הֽוּא׃ אֵ֥ל
verses.transliteration: kî lō ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh ’a·ḥêr lə·’êl kî Yah·weh šə·mōw qan·nā qan·nā hū ’êl
verses.literal: For you must not worship any other god for the LORD whose name [is] Jealous [is] a jealous . . . God

verses.original: פֶּן־ תִּכְרֹ֥ת בְּרִ֖ית לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזָנ֣וּ׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֗ם וְזָבְחוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְקָרָ֣א לְךָ֔ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ מִזִּבְחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- tiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·zā·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·zā·ḇə·ḥū lê·lō·hê·hem wə·qā·rā lə·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā miz·ziḇ·ḥōw
verses.literal: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to [them] they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִבְּנֹתָ֖יו לְבָנֶ֑יךָ בְנֹתָ֗יו וְזָנ֣וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ן בָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִזְנוּ֙ אֶת־ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mib·bə·nō·ṯāw lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā ḇə·nō·ṯāw wə·zā·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen bā·ne·ḵā wə·hiz·nū ’eṯ- ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen
verses.literal: And when you take some of their daughters as brides for your sons their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons [to do the same] - - . . .

verses.original: תַעֲשֶׂה־ לֹ֥א מַסֵּכָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ṯa·‘ă·śeh- lō mas·sê·ḵāh ’ĕ·lō·hê lāḵ
verses.literal: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves

verses.original: אֶת־ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֜ים לְמוֹעֵ֖ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֑יב תֹּאכַ֤ל מַצּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ךָ כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב יָצָ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- tiš·mōr ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm lə·mō·w·‘êḏ ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā kî bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ yā·ṣā·ṯā mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: - You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt

verses.original: פֶּ֥טֶר כָּל־ רֶ֖חֶם לִ֑י וְכָֽל־ פֶּ֖טֶר תִּזָּכָ֔ר מִקְנְךָ֙ שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: pe·ṭer kāl- re·ḥem lî wə·ḵāl pe·ṭer tiz·zā·ḵār miq·nə·ḵā šō·wr wā·śeh
verses.literal: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me including all the firstborn males among your livestock [whether] cattle or sheep

verses.original: תִּפְדֶּ֣ה וּפֶ֤טֶר חֲמוֹר֙ בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה כֹּ֣ל בְּכ֤וֹר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tip̄·deh ū·p̄e·ṭer ḥă·mō·wr ḇə·śeh wə·’im- lō ṯip̄·deh wa·‘ă·rap̄·tōw tip̄·deh kōl bə·ḵō·wr bā·ne·ḵā wə·lō- yê·rā·’ū p̄ā·nay rê·qām
verses.literal: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb but if you do not redeem it you are to break its neck You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons No one shall appear before Me empty-handed

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲבֹ֔ד הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּבַיּ֥וֹם תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת בֶּחָרִ֥ישׁ וּבַקָּצִ֖יר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·ḇōḏ haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm tiš·bōṯ be·ḥā·rîš ū·ḇaq·qā·ṣîr tiš·bōṯ
verses.literal: Six days you shall labor but on the seventh day you shall rest even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting you must rest

verses.original: לְךָ֔ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה וְחַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י חִטִּ֑ים קְצִ֣יר וְחַג֙ הָֽאָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā ta·‘ă·śeh wə·ḥaḡ šā·ḇu·‘ōṯ bik·kū·rê ḥiṭ·ṭîm qə·ṣîr wə·ḥaḡ hā·’ā·sîp̄ tə·qū·p̄aṯ haš·šā·nāh
verses.literal: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶת־ יֵרָאֶה֙ פְּנֵ֛י הָֽאָדֹ֥ן׀ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh kāl- zə·ḵū·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- yê·rā·’eh pə·nê hā·’ā·ḏōn Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Three times a year all your males . . . are to appear before the Lord GOD the God of Israel

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת־ גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְלֹא־ אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת־ יַחְמֹ֥ד אַרְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲלֹֽתְךָ֗ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃ לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·w·rîš gō·w·yim mip·pā·ne·ḵā wə·hir·ḥaḇ·tî ’eṯ- gə·ḇū·le·ḵā wə·lō- ’îš ’eṯ- yaḥ·mōḏ ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ba·‘ă·lō·ṯə·ḵā šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh lê·rā·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge - your borders and no one - will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear - before the LORD your God

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׁחַ֥ט דַּם־ זִבְחִ֑י עַל־ חָמֵ֖ץ וְלֹא־ זֶ֖בַח הַפָּֽסַח׃ חַ֥ג יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּ֔קֶר
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiš·ḥaṭ dam- ziḇ·ḥî ‘al- ḥā·mêṣ wə·lō- ze·ḇaḥ hap·pā·saḥ ḥaḡ yā·lîn lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to Me along with anything leavened and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning

verses.original: תָּבִ֕יא רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹא־ תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י אִמּֽוֹ׃פ בַּחֲלֵ֥ב
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇî rê·šîṯ bik·kū·rê ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō- ṯə·ḇaš·šêl gə·ḏî ’im·mōw ba·ḥă·lêḇ
verses.literal: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב־ לְךָ֖ אֶת־ הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים כִּ֞י עַל־ פִּ֣י׀ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים כָּרַ֧תִּי בְּרִ֖ית אִתְּךָ֛ וְאֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh kə·ṯāḇ- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm kî ‘al- pî hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm kā·rat·tî bə·rîṯ ’it·tə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses Write down - these words for in accordance with . . . these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֣ם עִם־ יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל לֶ֚חֶם שָׁתָ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב לֹ֣א וּמַ֖יִם עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִֽים׃ הַבְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י
verses.transliteration: way·hî- šām ‘im- Yah·weh ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh lō ’ā·ḵal le·ḥem šā·ṯāh way·yiḵ·tōḇ lō ū·ma·yim ‘al- hal·lu·ḥōṯ ’êṯ had·də·ḇā·rîm hab·bə·rîṯ ‘ă·śe·reṯ diḇ·rê
verses.literal: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking . . . . . . water [He wrote] on the tablets - the words of the covenant the Ten Commandments

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מֹשֶׁה֙ בְּרֶ֤דֶת מֵהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּשְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽעֵדֻת֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּיַד־ בְּרִדְתּ֖וֹ מִן־ הָהָ֑ר וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא־ יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖יו קָרַ֛ן בְּדַבְּר֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mō·šeh bə·re·ḏeṯ mê·har sî·nay ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ mō·šeh bə·yaḏ- bə·riḏ·tōw min- hā·hār ū·mō·šeh lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî ‘ō·wr pā·nāw qā·ran bə·ḏab·bə·rōw ’it·tōw
verses.literal: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands - - - he vvv was unaware that vvv his face had become radiant from speaking with [the LORD]

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכָל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑יו קָרַ֖ן וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מִגֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵāl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·yar mō·šeh wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·wr pā·nāw qā·ran way·yî·rə·’ū mig·ge·šeṯ ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Aaron and all the Israelites . . . - looked at Moses and behold vvv his face was radiant And they were afraid to approach him

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְכָל־ הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּעֵדָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛יו מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yiq·rā ’ă·lê·hem ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵāl han·nə·śi·’îm bā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yā·šu·ḇū ’ê·lāw mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: But Moses called out to them so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him and Moses spoke to them

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֥ן כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִגְּשׁ֖וּ וַיְצַוֵּ֕ם אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖וֹ דִּבֶּ֧ר בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nig·gə·šū way·ṣaw·wêm ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’it·tōw dib·ber bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: And after this all the Israelites . . . came near and [Moses] commanded them to do everything that the LORD . . . had told him on Mount Sinai

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיְכַ֣ל מִדַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן מַסְוֶֽה׃ עַל־ פָּנָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·ḵal mid·dab·bêr ’it·tām way·yit·tên mas·weh ‘al- pā·nāw
verses.literal: When Moses had finished speaking with them he put a veil over his face

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וּבְבֹ֨א לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת־ הַמַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד־ צֵאת֑וֹ וְיָצָ֗א וְדִבֶּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ū·ḇə·ḇō lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw yā·sîr ’eṯ- ham·mas·weh ‘aḏ- ṣê·ṯōw wə·yā·ṣā wə·ḏib·ber ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ ’ă·šer yə·ṣuw·weh
verses.literal: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him he would remove - the veil until he came out And when he came out he would tell . . . the Israelites . . . - what he had been commanded

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ וְרָא֤וּ כִּ֣י פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַמַּסְוֶה֙ וְהֵשִׁ֨יב עַל־ פָּנָ֔יו פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ עַד־ בֹּא֖וֹ לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- wə·rā·’ū kî pə·nê mō·šeh qā·ran ‘ō·wr mō·šeh ham·mas·weh wə·hê·šîḇ ‘al- pā·nāw pə·nê mō·šeh ’eṯ- ‘aḏ- bō·’ōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw
verses.literal: and the Israelites . . . - would see that the face of Moses was radiant . . . So Moses would put the veil back over . . . his face . . . - until he went in to speak with [the LORD]
